title: Window title
description: Shows the title of the window you are using.

placeholders.description: The title the window had when it opened.
The app name the window had when it opened.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how information should be displayed. On {} the current window title is displayed.
format.description: {title} is the window title, {class} the app name.

max-length.label: Maximum length
max-length.doc: The maximum length in character the module should display.
max-length.description: Cut the text when it is longer than this. Empty means no limit.

rewrite.label: Title replacements
rewrite.doc: Rules to rewrite window title. See rewrite rules.
rewrite.description: Rules that change titles before showing them, for example "(.*) - Mozilla Firefox" → " $1".

separate-outputs.label: Per monitor
separate-outputs.doc: Show the active window of the monitor the bar belongs to, instead of the focused window.
separate-outputs.description: Show the window of this bar's monitor, not the one you are using.

fallback.label: Text when no window
fallback.doc: Text to display when the focused window title is empty (for example when no window is focused).
fallback.description: Shown when no window is focused, for example on an empty desktop.

tooltip-format.label: Tooltip text
tooltip-format.doc: The format of the tooltip shown on hover. Supports the same replacements as format. Requires tooltip to be enabled. When unset, the tooltip falls back to the formatted label text.
tooltip-format.description: What the popup shows. It uses the same placeholders as the bar text.

icon.label: Show app icon
icon.doc: Option to hide the application icon.
icon.description: Option to hide the application icon.

icon-size.label: App icon size
icon-size.doc: Option to change the size of the application icon.
icon-size.description: Option to change the size of the application icon.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.
